outline: 本課程之目標為探討大地工程問題之解決方法。主要教授主題包括(1)土壤行為學、(2)土壤滲流、壓縮性以及強度問題、(3)邊坡穩定與基礎工程、(4)岩體力學行為探討、(5)岩石邊坡穩定性分析、(6)岩石隧道開挖及(7)大地工程可靠度分析。
schedule:
Week 1 Introduction
Week 2 Soil composition and soil behavior
Week 3 Seepage in soil
Week 4 Soil consolidation and compaction
Week 5 (Vacation) Notation, tensor, Mohr circle and elasticity
Week 6 Strength of soil
Week 7 Slope stability and retaining wall
Week 8 Foundation engineering
Week 9 Midterm exam
Week 10 Outcrop investigation and rock classifications
Week 11 Properties of intact rock
Week 12 Discontinuities in rock
Week 13 Behavior of jointed rock masses
Week 14 In-situ stress and rock hydraulics
Week 15 Rock slope stability
Week 16 Tunneling and rock masses excavation
Week 17 (Vacation) Geotechnical reliability analysis
Week 18 Final exam
assessment: 期中考(40%)、期末考(40%)、作業與出缺席 (20%)
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

5. Hoek, E. and Bray J. W. (1996), Rock Slope Engineering
